description: ADT doubling thickener on Vocal slot 5. No FX track, no mixer/send changes. Layers onto vocal-main.
name: adt-double
notes: Precondition: Vocal track selected, short delay loaded in slot 5. Apply vocal-main first, then this.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
If flanging, shorten Delay; if hollow in mono, lower Mix.
Response param field shows resolved titles; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Plugin mismatch names the actual insert plugin; adjust the plugin field and resend.
